lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. Blobs are arranged in approximately 6-8 distinguishable vertical columns between the gills and the dorsal fin region, with horizontal spacing increasing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with blob centroids, forming a grid pattern most visible in the mid-flank area above and posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible; the primary ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and shadow on the ventral aspect, extending longitudinally across the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of high-luminance spots is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located on the anterior and central regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of small, high-frequency luminance spots is located in the cephalic region, anterior to the first gill slit and posterior to the eye.
